name: Doxy.me vs SimplePractice
title: Doxy.me vs SimplePractice: Telehealth vs All-in-One EHR Comparison 2026
description: Compare Doxy.me telehealth platform with SimplePractice EHR. See pricing, features, and whether you need standalone telehealth or an all-in-one practice management solution.

summary.bottom_line: Doxy.me is a free, specialized HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform best for practices that already have an EHR or want dedicated video. SimplePractice is an all-in-one practice management platform including telehealth, EHR, billing, and scheduling. Choose Doxy.me for free telehealth alongside existing systems, SimplePractice for a complete practice solution.

sections.heading: Doxy.me vs SimplePractice: Different Tools for Different Needs
sections.content: Doxy.me and SimplePractice serve different primary purposes. Doxy.me is a specialized telehealth platform focused solely on HIPAA-compliant video visits - it's free, requires no patient downloads, and is used by 1.5+ million providers. SimplePractice is a comprehensive all-in-one practice management platform including EHR, telehealth, scheduling, billing, and client portal - designed to run your entire practice. The comparison is really about whether you need standalone telehealth or a complete practice solution.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Doxy.me offers a permanent free tier that includes HIPAA-compliant video, virtual waiting room, chat, and BAA - often sufficient for solo practitioners. Paid plans start at $29/month (Professional) adding HD video, screen sharing, and group calls. SimplePractice has no free tier - pricing starts at $49/month (Starter) for basic features, $79/month (Essential) adding telehealth, and $99/month (Plus) for insurance billing. If you only need telehealth and already have an EHR, Doxy.me is significantly cheaper.

sections.heading: Feature Comparison
sections.content: SimplePractice includes everything you need to run a practice: EHR with clinical notes, intake forms, scheduling, insurance billing, client portal, and telehealth. Doxy.me provides only video visits with a virtual waiting room - you'll need separate solutions for documentation, billing, and scheduling. Doxy.me's strength is simplicity and the patient experience (no downloads, just click a link). SimplePractice's telehealth is integrated into the broader workflow.

sections.heading: When to Use Each
sections.content: Many practices use Doxy.me alongside other EHRs - if you use TherapyNotes, Valant, or another EHR without strong telehealth, Doxy.me fills that gap for free. SimplePractice is best as a complete solution, not just for telehealth. Doxy.me won G2's 'Easiest to Use' award in 2025 and emphasizes patient ease (no downloads/accounts). SimplePractice has mobile apps and broader practice management features.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: The choice depends on what you already have:

recommendations.when: You already have an EHR/practice management system and just need HIPAA-compliant telehealth to complement it
You need a complete all-in-one solution for your practice including EHR, billing, scheduling, and telehealth
You want free, no-frills telehealth with the easiest patient experience (no downloads, no accounts)
You want integrated workflows where telehealth connects to notes, billing, and scheduling automatically
Budget is critical and you're comfortable managing separate systems for EHR and telehealth

faqs.q: Can I use Doxy.me with SimplePractice?
faqs.a: Yes, some practitioners use Doxy.me for telehealth even with SimplePractice, especially if they prefer Doxy.me's patient experience or started with Doxy.me before SimplePractice added telehealth. However, SimplePractice's integrated telehealth may be more convenient for workflow.

faqs.q: Is Doxy.me really free and HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, Doxy.me's free tier is fully HIPAA compliant with BAA included. The free version includes video visits, virtual waiting room, and chat. Paid plans add HD video, screen sharing, and group calls.
SimplePractice telehealth is included in the Essential ($79/mo) and Plus ($99/mo) plans but not the Starter ($49/mo) plan. The included telehealth is unlimited.

faqs.q: Which is better for patient experience?
faqs.a: Doxy.me is often considered easier for patients - they simply click a link to join with no downloads or account creation. SimplePractice telehealth also works in-browser but is part of a broader client portal experience.
